statewide_source.name: ODNR Statewide Parcels
statewide_source.vintage: CurrentTo 2023 for nearly all counties (Franklin 2024-03); no deed field

_meta.deed_formats: Ohio deeds are recorded by volume/page (older, often "OR" official-record volumes, e.g. Auglaize "OR 579"/2461, Champaign "OR603"/5401, Athens "625-1387or") or by recorder instrument number (Licking 201606100011903, Lorain 20130481143 in Deed_Volume, Trumbull 201504160006485, Fayette 202300003440). Several counties expose tax-map book/page that is NOT a deed (Cuyahoga book_page "B 001 P 01", Hamilton BOOK/PAGE inside PARCELID, Morrow TM_Page, Montgomery TAXBOOK/TAXPAGE).

status_legend.partial: owner+PID (no deed or low deed fill), statewide 2023 fallback, or lines+PID only
